categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of lithium battery ternary cathode material precursors, lithium salts, sulfates, nickel battery cathode materials, and high-purity electronic chemicals. It has diversified from a single product focus to include intermediates like sulfates and lithium carbonate, serving the lithium battery and nickel battery manufacturing industries, especially for new energy vehicles, power tools, robots, energy storage, and electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include wet metallurgy 'selective extraction without nickel extraction' for metal resource recycling, homogeneous co-precipitation for precursor synthesis, and advanced separation and purification techniques for nickel, cobalt, lithium, and manganese. The company also develops high-nickel and ultra-high-nickel ternary precursors using controlled particle morphology and size distribution, and has proprietary lithium extraction technologies with high recovery rates and purity, supported by multiple patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are lithium battery cathode and cell manufacturers such as Panasonic, BTR, BASF Shanshan, GEM, Tianli, BYD, Zheshang Zhongtuo, and Xiamen Xiangyu. The end markets include new energy vehicles, power tools, robotics, energy storage systems, and electronic products, with a focus on domestic and international lithium battery supply chains.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and production facilities in Jiangmen City, Guangdong Province. It has expanded upstream into lithium ore processing in Qingyuan, Guangdong, and established a subsidiary in Macau. Its customer base and sales cover domestic markets extensively and include some overseas sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the lithium battery supply chain, producing key cathode material precursors and intermediates such as nickel sulfate, cobalt sulfate, manganese sulfate, lithium carbonate, and spherical nickel hydroxide. It also engages upstream in raw material processing and downstream in supplying to cathode and cell manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-nickel and ultra-high-nickel ternary precursor development, lithium recovery and purification technologies, and expanding into high-purity electronic chemicals for semiconductor applications. The company emphasizes technological innovation, patent protection, and collaboration with universities for R&D, focusing on product performance, cost reduction, and environmental sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct product sales of lithium battery precursors, lithium salts, sulfates, and electronic chemicals to industrial customers. The company also has some indirect sales via trading customers. Revenue recognition is based on product delivery and customer acceptance, with contracts primarily at a point in time.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a competitive position in the high-nickel ternary precursor market with early mover advantages and a diversified product portfolio. It competes with other domestic and international lithium battery material suppliers, facing challenges from market demand fluctuations and industry consolidation. It is recognized as a specialized and innovative 'little giant' enterprise in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.16 billion, a 2.81% increase from 2023, but remained in a net loss position with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 426.77 million. The company has total assets around RMB 3.09 billion and equity of RMB 561 million, with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and technology upgrades. It has experienced volatility due to market demand and raw material price fluctuations but is pursuing diversification and efficiency improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced wet metallurgy and co-precipitation technologies enabling high-purity, cost-effective production of high-nickel ternary precursors and lithium salts. Its integrated resource recycling capabilities and proprietary lithium recovery processes provide environmental and cost advantages. The company offers customized products with strict quality control certified by IATF16949 and ISO standards, supporting high energy density and long cycle life for downstream battery manufacturers.
